5.10.validation: 2026.11.6.22 (5.10 only): fixes the load regression introduced with the vivo RSC QoS write. kernel_write is no longer a load-time import; it is resolved through kallsyms and called via a __nocfi wrapper, and only after /sys/rsc/qos/qos_enable or qos_cpu_enable opened successfully, so non-vivo kernels never look it up. OEM 5.10 GKI kernels that do not export kernel_write load again (previously: Unknown symbol kernel_write (err -2)). Other branches keep 2026.11.6.21.

5.15.validation: 2026.11.6.21 includes android17-6.18 in the same release: all six packages (5.10/5.15/6.1/6.6/6.12/6.18) are built from this source/kernel tree and published together. 6.18 uses its prepared 6.18.21 GKI tree, clang 21.1.0 and the CFI integer-normalization flag. The touch watchdog now uses timer_list plus a plain work_struct, with timer_delete_sync on 6.15+ and del_timer_sync on older branches, so the same source compiles for every release. 2026.11.6.20 made the install mode decide the layout: a normal install uses only the compiled offsets and never reads BTF; a force-adapted install resolves thread.debug from BTF and falls back to a read-only flush_ptrace_hw_breakpoint probe, and on 6.1 also resolves the four moving input_dev members from BTF or the input_allocate_device allocation size. The 6.1_vivo package is gone; one 6.1 package serves both GKI and vivo. The 5.10 branch writes /sys/rsc/qos/qos_enable and qos_cpu_enable to 0 at load and never restores them, avoiding the vivo RSC SVP scheduler brk #0x5512 on CE wake.
